verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so a per-framework readiness view is an applicable axis. The evidence does show multiple supported frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and others) and framework-linked controls that are added and removed automatically. However, nothing documents a readiness dashboard or percentage showing passing controls, open gaps, or remaining work per framework. Framework and control management is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.
